score_calibration.calibration_scope: training records only; held-out test records are not used to fit temperature
score_calibration.oof_imputation: fold-specific medians fitted only on each fold's training records
limitations: Temperature was fitted to grouped out-of-fold training scores and then applied to the final model fit on all training records.
Held-out test reliability must still be inspected; this is internal calibration, not external or clinical validation.
Calibration can be unstable when a class is represented by only a few training records or beats.

score_reliability.score_semantics: temperature-scaled normalised fuzzy rule scores (not calibrated probabilities); scalar temperature fitted from grouped OOF training scores
score_reliability.normalisation: each score row divided by its non-negative row sum; all-zero rows replaced by uniform scores
score_reliability.interpretation: These diagnostics evaluate the supplied score vectors on untouched held-out labels; no transform is fitted here. When available, the upstream temperature was fitted only from grouped out-of-fold training records. Internal calibration is not external or clinical validation, and score semantics remain model-specific.
